metadata.article_title: Presentment for payment of instrument payable at specified place and not elsewhere.

article.title: Presentment for payment of instrument payable at specified place and not elsewhere.
article.content:
68Presentment for payment of instrument payable at specified place and not elsewhere.

Section 68  ·  Chapter V  ·  page 18 of the Act
A promissory note, bill of exchange or cheque made, drawn or accepted payable at a specified place and not elsewhere must, in order to charge any party thereto, be presented for payment at that place.
